title: Bitcoin could go ‘sub-$50K if quantum isn’t solved by 2028: Capriole
summary: Quantitative Bitcoin and digital asset fund Capriole says the price of Bitcoin could plummet if the network doesn’t develop resistance to quantum computing.

title: Bhutan pledges 10K Bitcoin to develop its ‘mindfulness city’
summary: It’s estimated that Bhutan has around 11,286 Bitcoin in total, a stash worth over $986 million, making it the fifth-largest known holder among countries.

title: Saylor’s Bitcoin stash will be very hard for anyone to match: Pomp
summary: While it may be possible for a public company to catch up to Michael Saylor’s Strategy Bitcoin holdings, it is probably unlikely, Bitcoin entrepreneur Anthony Pompliano says.

title: Lightning Network hits record capacity on crypto exchange adoption
summary: Lightning Network’s capacity reached an all-time high as exchanges increased adoption, while a new Taproot Assets update has enabled multi-asset transactions.

title: Crypto lawyer says SAFE Crypto Act could deter scammers
summary: Newly proposed legislation could see the US Treasury, FinCEN, the Secret Service, and law enforcement coordinate to catch crypto scammers and fraudsters.

title: Exodus, MoonPay to roll out stablecoin in early 2026, joining gold rush
summary: Exodus partnered with MoonPay to launch a USD-backed stablecoin for everyday payments, integrating it into Exodus Pay for self-custodial transactions.

title: US government ‘tech force’ gets backup from Coinbase, Robinhood
summary: The US government wants 1,000 tech workers to boost its capabilities and has turned to the private sector to plug its skill shortages.

title: Aave founder outlines 2026 ‘master plan’ after end to SEC probe
summary: Aave’s 2026 plan focuses on scaling via v4's Hub and Spoke architecture, $1 billion in real-world assets, and growing its new mobile app.

title: Tether leads $8M funding for Lightning startup focused on stablecoins
summary: Speed, which leverages the Bitcoin Lightning Network to facilitate USDT transfers, has secured $8 million from Tether and Ego Death Capital.

title: Crypto ETPs to enter ‘cheesecake factory’ era in 2026: Bitwise
summary: The number of crypto exchange-traded products is going to “accelerate forward at ridiculous speed” in 2026, according to Bitwise researcher Ryan Rasmussen.
